usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the CSV parser in `main.wj`. It compiles and runs with `wj run --compiled`.

I ran it on a small input of my own. That input had an empty line, `,`, `"he said ""hi""",1`, `"x,y",z` and `"",a`. Every line gave the expected output. I did not run the two examples from the task statement exactly as written.

The parser reads a line one character at a time and tracks whether it is inside quotes
